Hi all — thanks, Olga. High level from Legal / Security intake below. Sara — copied verbatim so you have the checklist for our initial review:  

Required evidence (please upload or share a secure link):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) or a SOC 2 bridge letter + audit firm contact.
- Data processing addendum requests (if you have a standard privacy addendum or redlines, share them).
- Network diagram & a short description of connectivity (if you plan on Private/VPC setup).
- Exhibits we usually include: Exhibit A (Order Form SKUs/usage), Exhibit B (Billing & Invoicing), Exhibit C (Data Residency & Flow), Exhibit D (Encryption & KMS integration). If you have specific encryption requirements, please outline them.

Contract-specific asks / initial redlines we typically flag: 
- Residency carveouts (we can support EU-only for tenant data, will need to scope which product endpoints).
- SLA language for p99 latency — redundancy and fallback policies (Redwood offers fallback to a lower-cost variant; if you require firm latency SLOs we may need Dedicated or Private).
- Data retention / KV cache retention limits — confirm whether logs/inputs should be purged after X days.
- PO and invoicing — please confirm invoice recipient, payment terms (Net30/Net45) and whether a PO number will be provided on invoices.

Timeline expectation: once Party Sheet is complete and security artifacts uploaded we aim to return an initial MSA+OrderForm redline within 3 business days, then work with you on any iterative comments. For EU residency and dedicated/private deployment requests, there may be a short architecture verification step from Infra (Jonas will coordinate).

Please upload the docs to the Drive folder Olivia created (or send via DocuSign secure link). For quick sharing we accept an SFTP link or an invite to a protected Drive folder.

Related links for reference:  
- Intake party sheet template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_party_sheet
- HubSpot deal created: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/759123

If you're able, please confirm the signatory name and expected purchase order cadence and we'll draft the order form accordingly.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
